title: Size iPadOS content for viewing distance and input mode

statement.en: Use viewing distance and input mode to determine iPadOS content size and density.
statement.ja: viewing distanceとinput modeに基づいてiPadOS contentのsizeとdensityを決める。

conditions: Evaluate both the expected viewing distance and the active input mode.

rationale.en: Applying this guidance supports a consistent and usable Designing for iPadOS experience on the scoped Apple platforms.
rationale.ja: この指針は、対象AppleプラットフォームにおけるDesigning for iPadOSの一貫性と使いやすさを支えます。

manual: Does the design satisfy “Use viewing distance and input mode to determine iPadOS content size and density.” in the documented Designing for iPadOS context?

anti_patterns: Ignoring this guidance in a context where the source section applies.
positive_examples: A design review records how the implementation satisfies this rule and any source-scoped exception.

source.evidence_paraphrase: Use viewing distance and input mode to determine iPadOS content size and density.

apple_native_rule: Use viewing distance and input mode to determine iPadOS content size and density.
portable_interpretation: Preserve the user-centered intent after replacing Apple-specific platforms, components, and input conventions.

title: Support standard iPad input methods

statement.en: Let people use Multi-Touch gestures, a physical keyboard or trackpad, or Apple Pencil.
statement.ja: Multi-Touch gesture、physical keyboard、trackpad、Apple Pencilを利用できるようにする。

conditions: Support the input methods that apply to the experience instead of assuming touch alone.

rationale.en: Applying this guidance supports a consistent and usable Designing for iPadOS experience on the scoped Apple platforms.
rationale.ja: この指針は、対象AppleプラットフォームにおけるDesigning for iPadOSの一貫性と使いやすさを支えます。

title: Use the large iPad display for important content

statement.en: Use iPad’s large display to elevate important content and reduce modal interfaces and full-screen transitions.
statement.ja: iPadのlarge displayでimportant contentを高め、modal interfaceとfull-screen transitionを減らす。

conditions: Position onscreen controls where they are easy to reach without obstructing content.

rationale.en: Applying this guidance supports a consistent and usable Designing for iPadOS experience on the scoped Apple platforms.

title: Adapt iPadOS interfaces across configurations

statement.en: Adapt iPadOS interfaces across orientation, multitasking modes, Dark Mode, Dynamic Type, and macOS transitions.
statement.ja: iPadOS interfaceをorientation、multitasking mode、Dark Mode、Dynamic Type、macOS transitionへ適応させる。

conditions: Let people choose the configurations that work best for them.

title: Consider combining iPad input modes

statement.en: Consider unique iPad interactions that combine multiple input modes.
statement.ja: 複数のinput modeを組み合わせる独自のiPad interactionを検討する。

conditions: Treat combined input as an opportunity, not a requirement for simultaneous input.
